study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: A multimodal neural signature of face processing in autism within the fusiform gyrus

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative models trained using Bayesian linear regression (PCNtoolkit).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: normative models 58,61,62 were trained across all individuals using Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) 63 using PCNtoolkit package (version 0.26)

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: VBM-derived voxel-wise GM volumes (FFG ROI); task-fMRI faces>shapes T-contrast maps (FFG ROI); rs-fMRI FFA seed-based connectivity within FFG; EEG principal component of source-reconstructed time series.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Features for subsequent normative modeling were VBM-derived, voxel-wise GM volumes per individual restricted to the right and left FFG ROIs.; T-contrast maps per individual (restricted to the right and left FFG ROIs) were the features for subsequent normative modeling.; This FFA-connectivity was the feature for subsequent normative modeling.; The PC across these time series was used as the feature for subsequent normative modeling.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: 44220_2024_349_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: Supplementary Methods / Structural MRI data preprocessing; 44220_2024_349_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: Supplementary Methods / Functional task MRI data preprocessing; 44220_2024_349_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: Supplementary Methods / Resting-state fMRI: seed-based correlation analysis; 44220_2024_349_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: Supplementary Methods / EEG: Source analysis

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age (modeled with B-spline basis in primary analysis), sex, scanning site.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: modelling the relationship between each brain imaging modality (within the right and left FFG ROI) and age, sex and scanning site. In primary analysis, a B-spline basis expansion of the of covariate vector was used to model non-linear effects of age.
